description: Check a Base transaction BEFORE signing it. POST an UNSIGNED transaction `{ from, to, data?, value? }` and get three independent lenses: simulation against current state (does it revert?), decoded intent (is this an unlimited approval that outlives the trade?), and the counterparty liquidity-removal history from our own archive. Takes NO private key and NO signature, so the service cannot broadcast or front-run the transaction it inspects — a deliberate security property. It never returns "safe": a clean result means these checks found nothing, and the `limits` array says so in every response. Unpaid: free while the caller's IP has free-trial calls left that day (a small daily allowance shared across the trial stalls, no wallet); otherwise returns 402. (PAID x402 service — USDC on Base; the MCP server needs a funded wallet to settle.) Price: $0.008 USD (fixed).

data.description: Calldata hex (0x…); omit for a plain native transfer

from.description: Sender address. Asserted, never proven — no signature is taken.

value.description: Native value in wei as a decimal string; default 0
